title: FlowCatalyst function manifest
description: A function version's manifest (docs/spec/function-invocation.md §3, docs/spec/function-registry.md §4). This document is an editor/validation aid only — the manifest file itself is the source of truth (Manifest#parseStrict is the actual, authoritative reader); a rule this schema cannot express is named in the relevant property's description instead, by the validation code the platform will report at publish.

$schema.description: Optional: points an editor (VS Code, IntelliJ) at this document so manifest.json is validated as you type. Accepted and ignored by Manifest#parseStrict; never written back by Manifest#toJson, so publishing/promoting a version never stores it.

runtime.description: The runtime this version executes in. Must match the function's own runtime, or publish fails with RUNTIME_MISMATCH.

entrypoint.description: jvm: a binary class name implementing io.flowcatalyst.function.Function (^[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*(\.[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)*$), else ENTRYPOINT_INVALID. wasm: an export name (^[A-Za-z_]\w*$).

pool.description: The execution pool this version runs in, a DNS label. Defaults to "default" when absent.

warm.description: Whether the function should be kept warm (an idle instance held ready) rather than started on demand.

limits.description: Resource limits, resolved and frozen at publish: absent ⇒ min(platform default, the client's ceiling); present ⇒ must not exceed the ceiling (LIMIT_OVER_CEILING). Ceiling values themselves are a client policy the platform holds, not expressible here.

maxDurationMs.description: Maximum single-invocation duration, in milliseconds. Absent ⇒ the platform default clamped to the client's ceiling.

maxConcurrency.description: Maximum concurrent invocations for this version. Absent ⇒ the platform default clamped to the client's ceiling.

wasmMemoryMb.description: Wasm linear memory, in megabytes. Only applicable when runtime is "wasm" — present on a jvm function is LIMIT_NOT_APPLICABLE. Absent on a wasm function ⇒ the platform default clamped to the client's ceiling.

endpoints.description: The function's HTTP surface (function-invocation.md §3): how the host authenticates each path before the function sees it.

path.description: A route pattern (function-registry.md §5.2): literal segments, {param} segments, or a trailing *.

auth.description: How the host authenticates the call before the function sees it. Required — there is no default (ENDPOINT_AUTH_REQUIRED).

methods.description: Accepted methods. Absent/empty means every method. A webhook endpoint's methods, if given, must be exactly ["POST"] (ENDPOINT_INVALID).

origins.description: Allowed origins: "*", or scheme://host[:port] with no path/query/fragment. "*" together with allowCredentials: true is rejected (ENDPOINT_INVALID).

maxBodyBytes.description: Maximum accepted request body size, in bytes.

timeoutMs.description: Per-call timeout, in milliseconds, held to the ceiling of limits.maxDurationMs (LIMIT_OVER_CEILING). Absent ⇒ this version's own maxDurationMs.

subscriptions.description: Event-type subscriptions the platform creates at promote (function-invocation.md §3, §4). Not expressible here: the event type must exist (EVENT_TYPE_NOT_FOUND), and path must match a webhook endpoint of this manifest (SUBSCRIPTION_PATH_NOT_WEBHOOK) — both checked against the database at promote/validate time.

path.description: The literal delivery path (no {param}/*); must resolve to a webhook endpoint of this manifest (SUBSCRIPTION_PATH_NOT_WEBHOOK).

mode.description: Router ordering mode for this subscription.

dataOnly.description: Deliver only the event's data, not the whole envelope.

schedules.description: Cron schedules the platform creates at promote (function-invocation.md §3, §4). Not expressible here: cron/timezone validity, and path must match a webhook endpoint of this manifest (SCHEDULE_PATH_NOT_WEBHOOK) — both checked at promote/validate time.

path.description: The literal delivery path (no {param}/*); must resolve to a webhook endpoint of this manifest (SCHEDULE_PATH_NOT_WEBHOOK).

payload.description: Opaque JSON delivered with each firing. Absent means none.

public.description: (hostname, pathPrefix) pairs the platform exposes on the public listener for this function (function-invocation.md §3, §5). Not expressible here: the hostname's domain must be claimed by this function's owner, and the (hostname, pathPrefix) pair must not already be taken by another function (PUBLIC_ROUTE_TAKEN) — both checked against the database at promote/validate time.

hostname.description: A public hostname (function-registry.md §5.1): lower-cased, ≤253 characters, at least two DNS labels, no wildcard/port/trailing dot, not an IP literal.

pathPrefix.description: A literal path prefix, stripped before endpoint matching. Absent ⇒ "/".

aliasPrefixes.description: Opt-in alias name prefixes (function-zones-and-aliases.md §3): each a DNS label, never "live", no duplicates. Absent/empty means exact-hostname match only.

config.description: Required config variable names this version needs at runtime (function-context.md §1).

secrets.description: Required secret references this version needs at runtime.

name.description: The connection's local name, a DNS label, unique within this manifest.

poolSize.description: Connection pool size, held to the client's dbPoolSize ceiling (LIMIT_OVER_CEILING). Absent ⇒ the platform default clamped to the ceiling.

httpAllow.description: Outbound hosts this version may call.
